source.excerpt: Shared as an editorial illustration bot for posts and announcements.

body:
## What it does

Close to zero setup: hand it the announcement or the post and it comes back with an illustration built around a mascot rather than a stock-looking image. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @trevin shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
